problem_register_class: RC1 / RC2 Taiwan refresh readback false failures (market data domain; cb4f6795)

failure_line_and_cause.failing_expression: raw_date = row.get("date") if row.get("date") is not None else record_metadata.get("date"); ... if not record_date and raw_date is None and connector_id == "tw-official-twse-margin-balances":
failure_line_and_cause.explanation: TaiwanOfficialMarketDatasetAdapter._normalize_margin_row sets normalized_row['date'] = '' and metadata['date'] = '' because TWSE OpenAPI MI_MARGN rows carry no date field. In verify_bounded_source_refresh_readback, line 1973 evaluated row.get('date') is not None to True for '', setting raw_date = '', and line 1978 gated the event-time fallback on raw_date is None (False when raw_date == ''), leaving record_date = '' and failing at line 2002 with "bounded chip provider session '' != requested session '2026-11-18' for tw-official-twse-margin-balances". By contrast, check_taiwan_refresh_preflight at line 2611 used an truthy `or` chain (`metadata.get('date') or ...`), treating '' as missing and deriving 2026-11-18 from available_time via latest_published_chip_session.

pre_fix_reproduction_result.stderr: bounded chip provider session '' != requested session '2026-11-18' for tw-official-twse-margin-balances (provider_session='', expected_session='2026-11-18')

failure_line_and_cause.failing_expression: accept=lambda rec: rec.get("connector_id") == connector_id and str((rec.get("provenance") or {}).get("source_ingest_run_id") or "") in run_ids
failure_line_and_cause.explanation: SourceRecord.to_dict() serialized by /api/source-ingest/source-records (and /api/source-ingest/source-records/{source_id}) has no top-level 'provenance' key (rec.get('provenance') is None); source_ingest_run_id is stored at rec['metadata']['source_ingest_run_id'] ('provenance' is only synthesized on controller/readback's latest_source_record). Line 2179 checked only rec.get('provenance'), matching 0 of the 120 records of ingest-78b81ff0f04d even though all 120 carried complete metadata.refresh_coverage for ['2330', '2317', '0050'], and raised at line 2182 with "FinMind bounded refresh status=partial: covered=[] missing=['2330', '2317', '0050']; not accepted as fresh". In addition, line 2393 fetched all 14,654 rows (62.5 MB) from /api/source-ingest/source-records instead of a bounded per-run read.

pre_fix_reproduction_result.stderr: FinMind bounded refresh status=partial: covered=[] missing=['2330', '2317', '0050']; not accepted as fresh

twse_margin_shared_session_helper.detail: Defined once in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh and loaded by both check_taiwan_refresh_preflight and verify_bounded_source_refresh_readback so they cannot diverge. Treats empty date strings identically to missing dates, falls back to event/available/source_timestamp through latest_published_chip_session, and returns an explicit error naming all missing date and event_time fields (metadata.date, metadata.normalized_row.date, provenance.trade_date, provenance.event_time, metadata.event_time, provenance.available_time, metadata.available_time, latest_receipt.source_timestamp, freshness.source_timestamp) when both are absent.

finmind_broker_run_id_and_bounded_per_ru.detail: finmind_record_run_id reads source_ingest_run_id from either provenance.source_ingest_run_id or metadata.source_ingest_run_id so stored SourceRecord.to_dict() payloads match run_ids. fetch_finmind_source_records performs a bounded per-run read inside the source-ingest container under the strict JWT/tenant guard via GET /api/source-ingest/receipts?connector_id=tw-finmind-broker-daily-report -> GET /api/source-ingest/evidence/bundles/{evidence_bundle_id} -> GET /api/source-ingest/source-records/{source_id} (1 representative record per symbol in the run's bundle: 3 records in 0.148s on hosted dev instead of 14,654 records / 62.5 MB in 8.005s).

runtime_budget.finmind_readback_bound: Reads at most the records of one run (1 representative record per symbol from the verified run's evidence_bundle, <= 25 records per batch run; 3 records / ~4.5 KB in 0.148s on hosted dev vs 14,654 records / 62.5 MB before). Ephemeral mktemp file is removed on function exit.
